description: List Coverage Cat documentation topics from the same consumer MCP connection and return each topic's title, category, URI, MIME type, summary, and public href.

category.description: Docs category to browse: `developers` for guides such as quickstart, auth, sandbox, and MCP setup, `api` for discovery and OpenAPI documents, `skills` for runtime skill guides, or `all`. Omit it to browse every category.

limit.description: How many topics to return from the start of the filtered catalog. Omit it to get up to 25.

name: docs_list_topics

href.description: Public web URL for the same content.

mime_type.description: Format of the resource body, such as `text/markdown` or `text/yaml`.

uri.description: Resource URI to pass to docs_get_resource.

total.description: Number of topics in this response after limit, not the size of the whole catalog.

title: Coverage Cat docs topic index
